newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Optique to acquire VSI for stock.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Optique to acquire VSI for stock.

text.p: Ocean Optique Distributors Inc said on Friday it agreed to acquire VSI International Inc in a stock swap that would give VSI holders an 80 percent stake in Ocean Optique.
Myron Orlinsky, chairman and chief executive officer of VSI, will become chairman and chief executive officer of Ocean. VSI markets and distributes non-prescription sunglasses and reading glasses.
On a combined basis, the company is expected to have annualized revenues in excess of $26 million.
Ocean Optique said it anticipated closing the deal in December, pending the execution of a definitive agreement.
The dollar value of the deal was not immediately available.
